title: The Origin and Progress of the Mechanical Inventions of James Watt, Volume II: Extracts from Correspondence
lineage: Published edition of correspondence, not the manuscript; p. x dates letter 146 April 24, 1775 while heading on p. 84 prints April 24, 1776. Retrospective publication establishes public disclosure; attribution of the cylinder supplier is checked through Andrew.

passages.note: Title page; contents p. x; letters 146–150, printed pp. 84–90 (PDF pp. 118–124)
